name: planilex
description: Controle de previsão de gastos do casamento e da montagem da casa

scripts.site:rapido: npm run build -w @planilex/web && npm run start -w @planilex/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @planilex/db && npm run dev -w @planilex/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @planilex/db && npm run build -w @planilex/api && npm run build -w @planilex/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run migrate:dev -w @planilex/db && npm run build -w @planilex/db
scripts.db:backup: npm run build -w @planilex/db --silent && npm run backup -w @planilex/db --
scripts.db:importar: npm run build -w @planilex/db --silent && npm run importar -w @planilex/db --
